single_behavior: Rising diagonal orders its three cells as side then top then side, rather than top then two sides. Flat and cardinal paths unchanged.
hypothesis: Top-first cannot clear the player body until late ascent; placing an exposed side first may use that time and leave an earlier final confirmation/return. Geometry and actual confirmation still gate every press.
reference_scope: Reviewed creator relay shows interleaved side/raised cells and continuous sweep, but perspective does not establish exact input order. This is a testable local physics hypothesis, not a claimed frame-derived fact.
outcome: NE35 andSW35 contacts survived, but speed3.442/3.450 BPS vs native-motion short samples3.465/3.496. No demonstrated tempo gain; not retained.
